names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 20 august, «Sfântul Mucenic Teoharie», with the rank words left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro: «a fost ucis cu pietre și apoi spânzurat de un plop, pe 20 august 1740». The page gives no birth year.

attestations.note: His life closes: «Sfântul Mucenic Teoharie este prăznuit de Biserica Ortodoxă pe 20 august», the day on which he was killed.
Not checked: saint.gr for 20 Αυγούστου (24 September 2026). Doxologia's life makes him a Greek of Cappadocia whose relic is at Thessalonica, so the Greek row is the one most likely to be fillable.
